concerns_addressed: Ready timeout 30s not in ConfigDefaults: confirmed (ConfigDefaults has no target.* keys); it is consistent with spec ('ready defaults path / timeout 30s') and with DEFAULT_READY_TIMEOUT in src/runtime/target.ts:173. Example is commented and schema-valid. Literal could be imported (Minor).

Context example literal src/**: context has no default, so it is illustrative; valid per schema (context.include string array). Header says 'shown with their defaults' which slightly overstates for context (Minor).
Null-framework hint 'no known framework': accurate, accepted.
Reason wording: accepted; non-object scripts map to no-script reason 'has no dev or start script', which is truthful and spec A8 only requires a why-comment.
Duplicated readRendered/validate helpers across the two test files: Minor duplication (2 copies, below 3x heuristic).

strengths: All interpolations verified: pm and script are fixed sets (type-level 'dev'|'start', PM_NAMES), port is a validated integer 1..65535 from detect.ts, framework name comes only from the fixed FRAMEWORKS table; raw scriptText only reaches a sanitised, capped single-line comment.
Sanitiser replaces \p{Cc} (incl. CR, LF, NUL, U+0085), \p{Cf} (incl. BOM, bidi) and U+2028/2029; hint line capped at 120 chars after '# ' accounting for prefix/suffix, truncation is surrogate-safe.

Output validated through the real readAndParseConfigFile + ConfigSchema in detected, unknown-port and all four fallback branches; url is http://localhost:<port> paired with start; version: 0 matches z.literal(0).

Fallback target block fully commented; manually traced that uncommenting it yields valid start/url/ready.path; commented examples use ConfigDefaults values and correct schema key names (uncertainty-band, on-uncertain, max-steps, fail-on, viewport).

Tests would fail on regression: hostile cases assert no injected assessment/output/runtime/jev keys, single hint line, <=120 chars, no control chars; property test pipes fc-generated package.json through detectProject -> renderConfig -> reader/schema (200 runs) and checks loopback url/port range/start pairing.
npx vitest run src/init/: 4 files, 67 tests pass; tsc --noEmit clean. ConfigSchema/defaults untouched; detection imported, not reimplemented.
